_comment: External dependency: the pi_agent_rust GitHub release this extension is built and tested against. `tag` is the SINGLE pinned value — bump only it to move the supported floor. The managed download (src/rust-install.ts) fetches this tag; the README 'Rust Pi (tested)' badge reads it; a user-supplied binary of a different version gets a one-time warning (src/extension.ts). Dependabot can't track GitHub releases natively — .github/workflows/upstream-currency.yml opens an issue when a newer release appears, using the `datasource`/`repo`/`tag` fields below.
_glibcWarning: WHY THIS IS STILL v0.3.0 AND NOT v0.5.1. The v0.5.1 Linux binaries require GLIBC_2.43 (measured: objdump -T on pi-linux-arm64 and pi-linux-amd64); v0.3.0 requires only 2.39. 2.43 is newer than Debian 13 (2.41) or Ubuntu 24.04 (2.39), so on a mainstream Linux host the managed download cannot exec — it fails in the dynamic linker. This was not theoretical: bumping the pin to v0.5.1 made the extension download a binary that would not start, and the session failed with "RPC 'get_state' timed out after 15000ms" rather than anything naming a library. macOS and Windows are unaffected. Before bumping again, check the release's glibc floor against the Linux versions we support, and verify the managed install on one of them.
